title: Personal Auto policy
fideon:note: Generated from the supplied personal_auto.schema.json v1.4.0 by scripts/build_canonical_policy.py. Do not hand-edit; edit the source and regenerate. Hand-extended to v1.5.0: see fideon:source.change_log.

fideon:source.external_gap_analysis_notes: 2026-09-25: personal auto gap analysis of 26 PDFs from 8 carriers (AEIC, Hagerty, MAPFRE, Mercury, NYCM, Plymouth, Progressive, Travelers). 89 schema nodes added (declarations form number, NY DMV insurer code, original inception date, purchase date/time, product code, named/co-insured demographics, contact table, insurance score vendor, per-vehicle MVLE fee / optional coverages premium / discount total, supplemental spousal liability premium and rate, remittance and bill-plan options, UM and SUM per-person/per-accident limits, statutory UM and SUM out-of-state indicators, no-fault benefit periods, transportation and substitute transportation daily/maximum limits, roadside towing distance, rental vehicle coverage premium-charge election, coverage_packages[], vehicle/driver change status, accident prevention course date, class code components, residence type, id_cards[], printed name on declination forms); printed labels added as aliases on existing fields. Misplaced aliases moved: Inception Date (policy.effective_date -> policy.original_inception_date), Coverage Details and Coverage Summary (auto.liability_coverages -> auto.vehicles[].coverages[] / document.document_title_as_stated); ISSUE DATE on auto.drivers[].date_licensed replaced by LICENSE ISSUE DATE; Roadside Assistance now also names auto.physical_damage_coverages.roadside_assistance_limit. Merged duplicate fields: auto.physical_damage_coverages.other_than_collision_deductible -> comprehensive_deductible; auto.no_fault_benefits.basic_economic_loss_limit -> mandatory_pip_limit. Applied directly to this file. Gold review (same day, 23 generated samples checked against their scans): Name -> named_insured.primary_name (was taken by third_party_designee.name); Actual Cash Value off physical_damage_coverages.valuation_basis; Comprehensive / Other Than Collision / Collision moved to the premium fields (the amount printed after them is the premium) and Comprehensive deductible / Collision deductible added to the deductibles; bare Bodily Injury / Property Damage / EACH ACCIDENT removed (they matched discount lines); EFF DATE moved to document.transaction_effective_date; Pay in Full / Pay in Installments moved to the option totals; auto.vehicles[].unit_description and auto.vehicles[].total_loss_settlement_basis declared (the generator writes both). Bare 'Comprehensive' / 'Collision' removed from the premium fields: the amount printed after them is the premium on some forms (Hagerty) and the deductible on others (Plymouth). billing.remittance_payable_to renamed billing.payable_to, the name the generator writes.
change_log: 1.5.0 (2026-09-29): added named_insured.all_named_insureds[].name. Every name the declarations' insured block prints, in order (one, two or more) -- the primary first. Built only from that block, never from an insured-summary table; see _header_named_insureds in fideon/l1/registry_extractor.py.

original_inception_date.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 13 of the 22 lines. The date the policy FIRST incepted, which a renewal states beside its own term -- North Country prints `Inception Date`. Distinct from `effective_date` and from `anniversary_date`.

renewal_offer.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 12 of the 22 lines. Whether the carrier is offering renewal, and on what terms. A compliance fact on any non-renewal.

rating_state.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 9 of the 22 lines. The state whose rates apply -- not always where the policy was issued (`carrier.state_of_issue`), nor where the risk sits.

policy_tier.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 8 of the 22 lines. NYCM prints `Tier: 9`. A rating tier moves the premium and had no slot, so it travelled in `additional_fields` flagged as unverified.

cancellation_method.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 8 of the 22 lines. HOW a policy was cancelled -- flat, pro-rata, short rate. `cancellation_date` and `cancellation_reason` exist; the method is what decides the refund.

non_assessable_cooperative.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 7 of the 22 lines. Whether a co-operative may assess its members. Printed on the face of every Leatherstocking declaration, and a statement about the policyholder's liability rather than the carrier's.

quote_number.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 4 of the 22 lines. The quote this policy was issued from. NYCM prints `QUOTE #: Q31829763` on every page.

policy_term_as_printed.fideon:repo_addition: The policy term EXACTLY as the page states it, whichever form that takes. Carriers print two: a duration (`Policy Term: 12 Months`) and a date range (`Policy Term: 02/29/2024 to 02/28/2025`). `policy_term_months` counts months, so a carrier printing the range had its date pair written into a numeric field -- Plymouth Rock shipped `policy_term_months: "02/29/2024 to 02/28/2025"`, which is wrong for anyone who trusts the field name, and aliasing the two together would make that the intended behaviour. The alternative was to leave the range in `additional_fields`, flagged. Rejected: every carrier prints the term in one of these two forms, so that is a recurring flagged unknown for a fact the page states plainly. Keeping both fields means `policy_term_months` stays a number and the printed form survives as the audit trail; the date range itself is also in `effective_date`/`expiration_date`, and this says what the page said.

has_signature.fideon:repo_addition: Whether the declarations page carries a signature at all. The supplied `signature` block models the signature's CONTENTS -- representative name, title, dates -- and has no key for its presence, so a reader that checks for one had nowhere to report it and the answer travelled in `additional_fields` on every document. An unsigned declarations page is a compliance question, so `false` is a finding rather than an absence.
